command: set -eu; npm run typecheck:src; npx --no-install eslint bin/git-warp.ts src/ports/CliFailureClassifierPort.ts src/ports/CliFailureHostPort.ts src/infrastructure/adapters/CliFailure*.ts test/unit/infrastructure/adapters/CliFailure*.test.ts; set +e; npx --no-install vitest run test/unit/infrastructure/adapters/CliFailureProjectionAdapter.test.ts test/unit/infrastructure/adapters/CliFailureReporterAdapter.test.ts test/unit/infrastructure/adapters/CliFailureValidation.test.ts --maxWorkers=2 --coverage --coverage.include="src/infrastructure/adapters/CliFailure*.ts" --coverage.reporter=json --coverage.reportsDirectory=/data/coverage-cli --coverage.thresholds.lines=100 --coverage.thresholds.functions=100 --coverage.thresholds.branches=100 --coverage.thresholds.statements=100; result=$?; set -e; python3 -c 'import json;from pathlib import Path;x=json.loads(Path("/data/coverage-cli/coverage-final.json").read_text());print("CLI_COVERAGE="+json.dumps({k:{"uncovered_statements":[n for n,v in c["s"].items() if not v],"uncovered_functions":[n for n,v in c["f"].items() if not v],"uncovered_branches":{n:v for n,v in c["b"].items() if not all(v)}} for k,c in x.items()}))'; exit "$result"
